method: Bengaluru-first Pega intelligence layer built from the maintained 159-row hub universe, team_intelligence_enriched.json, pega_full_audit.json, team_insider_2026-11.json and fresh public web/search-index checks. tiers.name: Apply first — Bengaluru strong fit
tiers.why: Best combination of Bengaluru seat evidence, direct GCC/product ownership, current or recent hiring signal, and fit to Pega + integrations + production ownership.

tiers.name: Apply selectively / referral-led

tiers.name: Monitor / verify before spending energy
tiers.why: Bengaluru or Pega evidence exists, but current direct role evidence is thinner, global-only, older, operations/RPA-heavy, or not clearly your 4-year Pega band.
